templates.name_en: Select a labeled can into an order tray while preserving a distractor
templates.name_ja: 誤選択缶を残したままラベル付き缶を注文トレーへ選ぶ
preconditions: target and distractor labels are visible
candidate set is stable and reachable
order tray is empty and reachable
goals: destination and candidate set remain stable
failure_modes: wrong can selected
distractor moved with target
label is occluded
tray or can is unstable

templates.name_en: Orient a marked object surface toward a fixed camera
templates.name_ja: 表面マークを固定カメラへ向ける
preconditions: marked object and distractor are visible and reachable
surface mark and camera pose are fixed
goals: surface mark faces the fixed camera
marked object and surface remain stable
failure_modes: mark faces away
distractor is displaced
camera view is occluded
replica rolls or overhangs
